account.description: Role, sign-in state and linked identities.

notice.roleChanged: The role was changed. The user was signed out everywhere.

roleDialog.description: The new role is {{role}}. Changing the role signs the user out of every session.

resetDialog.description: A temporary password is generated and shown once. The user is signed out everywhere and must choose a new password at the next sign-in.

resetResult.label: Temporary password

storage.title: Storage and quota
storage.description: Usage across My Files and Received, and the quota that applies to this user.

belowUsage.title: This quota is below the storage already in use
belowUsage.description: Nothing is deleted. The user can't add new files until usage falls under the quota.

storage.noBypass: Administrators get no quota bypass: the same limits apply to every account.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Where this user is currently signed in.
sessions.none: This user has no active sessions.

notice.deactivated: The user was deactivated and signed out everywhere.
notice.sessionsRevoked: Every session of this user was signed out.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this user
deactivate.description: Signs the user out everywhere and blocks sign-in. Files and shares are kept.
deactivate.dialogDescription: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you reactivate the account.

activate.title: Reactivate this user
activate.description: Lets the user sign in again. Previously revoked sessions stay revoked.

revoke.title: Sign out of all sessions
revoke.description: Ends every session of this user. Trusted devices are kept.
revoke.dialogDescription: Every session of this user ends immediately and they must sign in again.

hints.publicLinkPasswordMinLength: Applies to passwords on Shares and Reverse Shares.
hints.maxLoginAttempts: Consecutive failures before the account is locked.
hints.loginLockoutMinutes: How long a locked account stays locked.
hints.sessionIdleDays: Sessions end after this much inactivity.
hints.sessionAbsoluteDays: Sessions end after this long, however active.
hints.recentAuthMinutes: How long a confirmed password counts for sensitive actions.
hints.passwordResetValidityMinutes: How long an e-mailed reset link works.
hints.inviteValidityHours: Used when an invite doesn't set its own expiry.
hints.trustedDeviceDurationDays: How long a trusted device skips the second factor.
hints.twoFactorRequired: Local accounts must enroll before they can use Palmr.
hints.trustedDevicesEnabled: Lets people skip the second factor on devices they trust.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.description: Storage and upload limits. Unlimited is different from zero.

hints.defaultUserQuotaBytes: Applies to users without their own override. Zero means no storage at all.
hints.maxFileSizeBytes: The largest single file anyone can upload. Zero blocks every upload.

publicLinks.title: Public links
publicLinks.description: How long Shares and Reverse Shares may stay available.
publicLinks.hint: Links can't be created with a longer expiry.

smtp.pageDescription: Outgoing e-mail for invitations, password resets and notifications.
smtp.title: Mail server
smtp.description: Palmr works without e-mail. Features that need it stay unavailable until it is configured.

fields.passwordPlaceholder: Enter a new password to replace it
fields.allowSelfSignedHint: Only for servers you control. Weakens certificate checking.

password.willClear: Will be removed when you save
password.willReplace: Will be replaced when you save

clearDialog.title: Clear the saved password?
clearDialog.description: The password is removed when you save. E-mail that needs authentication stops working until you enter a new one.

test.title: Send a test e-mail
test.description: Checks the connection, TLS, sign-in and delivery.
test.unsavedHint: Testing the form values doesn't save them and never uses the saved password. Enter the password above if the server requires one.
test.unsavedIncomplete: Enter a host, port and sender address to test the form values.
test.succeeded: The test e-mail was sent using the {{mode}}.
test.incomplete: The test did not complete using the {{mode}}.

providers.title: Identity providers
providers.description: Let people sign in with OpenID Connect or OAuth2 providers. Client secrets are write-only and are never shown again.

global.label: Allow external sign-in
global.hint: When off, no provider is offered on the sign-in page.
global.offNotice: External sign-in is off. Providers stay configured, but nobody can use them until it is turned back on.

empty.title: No providers yet
empty.description: Add a preset or a custom OpenID Connect or OAuth2 provider to enable single sign-on.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The provider is removed and can no longer be used to sign in. This can't be undone.
delete.linked: {{total}} linked accounts still use this provider. Remove those links first; the provider can't be deleted while they exist.

form.presetHint: Presets fill in the usual settings. You can adjust everything before saving.
form.slugHint: 2–40 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. It becomes part of the redirect URI and can't be changed later.
form.issuerHint: Palmr reads the provider's settings from this address.
form.secretWriteOnly: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored secret. Type a new value to replace it.
form.secretPlaceholderConfigured: Configured. Enter a new secret to replace it
form.scopesHint: Type a scope and press Enter. OpenID Connect providers must request openid.

autoProvision.label: Create accounts automatically
autoProvision.hint: Eligible new people get an account the first time they sign in. These accounts are always regular users, never administrators.

allowEmailLinking.label: Link by verified e-mail
allowEmailLinking.hint: A sign-in is linked to the existing account with the same e-mail only when the provider states the e-mail is verified.

enabled.label: Enable now
enabled.hint: Enabled providers appear on the sign-in page.

consequences.title: What these settings do
consequences.autoProvision: Automatic account creation only applies to people who don't have an account yet.
consequences.emailLinking: E-mail linking never applies to unverified e-mail addresses.
consequences.manualLinking: People can always connect this provider manually from their security settings, whatever these settings say.

form.redirectAfterCreate: The redirect URI is shown after the provider is created.

validation.slug: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
validation.openid: OpenID Connect providers must include the openid scope.
validation.slugTaken: This slug is already used by another provider.

passwordLogin.title: Password sign-in
passwordLogin.description: Turn off local password sign-in to make this instance single sign-on only.
passwordLogin.explainOn: People with a password can sign in with it. Turning it off is only possible when an administrator can still sign in through a tested provider.
passwordLogin.explainOff: Only external providers can be used to sign in. If every provider becomes unusable, an operator can recover access from the command line.

blockers.title: Password sign-in can't be turned off yet

paths.title: Administrator sign-in paths
paths.description: Active administrators linked to an enabled provider. Turning password sign-in off also requires a provider tested successfully in the last 24 hours. Once it is off, changes that would remove the last of these paths are refused.
paths.empty: No active administrator is linked to an enabled provider.

disable.title: Turn off password sign-in?
disable.intro: Check these consequences before you continue.

points.unavailable: Local password sign-in becomes unavailable for everyone, including you.
points.admission: Palmr only allows this when an enabled provider has been tested successfully in the last 24 hours and is linked to an active administrator, including you.
points.standing: Afterwards, changes that would remove the last administrator sign-in path through a provider are refused.
points.recovery: If you get locked out, an operator can recover access from the command line.

disable.understood: I understand that password sign-in will stop working.
